subject: Supplier tax setup & PO readiness — NovaPower onboarding
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@novapower.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier tax setup & PO readiness — NovaPower onboarding

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for agreeing to be set up as a supplier for Redwood. To get you fully into our finance system and enable POs and ACH payments, we need a short set of items from NovaPower. Below is the minimal checklist to keep things moving: 

- Completed W-9 (for US entities) or W-8BEN-E (for foreign entities) — signed PDF
- Legal company name and remit address (for PO generation)
- EIN or tax ID confirmation
- Banking info (ACH) — voided check or bank letter (please do NOT send account numbers over insecure channels; the portal link below is preferred)
- Preferred payment terms (Net 30 / 45 / 60) and any invoicing notes
- Completed vendor portal registration (link below)

I've attached a short supplier_setup_checklist.pdf that summarizes the steps and where to upload documents. You can either attach them to this thread or upload via the vendor portal: https://redwoodinference.app/vendor-portal/forms/NP-9923

If you can get the W-9 and remit address over this week we'll open a PO and target the first invoice for processing in our Oct cycle. Monica on AP is copied to confirm acceptance criteria.

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: supplier_setup_checklist.pdf

Thanks for the clear checklist. NovaPower is a US-headquartered LLC so W-9 applies. Attached is our completed and signed W-9 (W-9_NovaPower_202508.pdf). Our EIN is on the form — if you need that listed separately for your portal, let me know.

Remit address for PO: 
NovaPower Inc.
1524 Harbor Way
Suite 700
San Diego, CA 92101

We typically prefer Net 30. For banking, we can upload ACH details via your portal (recommended) — if you need a short confirmation from our bank we can provide a bank letter. I'm copying our accounts-payable alias (accounts-payable@novapower.co) if AP needs to provide anything else.

Attached: W-9_NovaPower_202508.pdf

Cheers,
Sarah Lin
Director, Finance Operations
NovaPower Inc.

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the W-9 — that's great. Two quick follow-ups so we can finish the vendor record: 

1) Can you confirm the exact EIN number in plain text for our portal entry? We redact attachments for storage but the portal field requires the digits.
2) We need a remittance email or postal remit address for PO/invoice routing (the address you supplied is fine; please confirm the remit email if different).
3) For ACH, we'll need either a voided check image or a bank letter verifying routing/account name (you can upload to the portal page linked below).

Portal instructions are attached (vendor_portal_instructions.pdf). If you prefer, we can send a secure DocuSign packet to capture the bank authorization — let us know which you prefer.

Once we have EIN and the voided check/bank letter, we'll create the vendor and issue a preliminary PO within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
AP Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor_portal_instructions.pdf
